loanHistoryBefore:
case
        when item->>'kind' = 'loan'
        then case when coalesce(item->>'balance', '0') ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
          then least(9000000000000::numeric, round((item->>'balance')::numeric)) else 0 end
        else 0
      end
loanHistoryAfter:
case
        when item->>'kind' = 'loan'
        then case when coalesce(item->>'balance', '0') ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
          then least(9000000000000::numeric, abs(round((item->>'balance')::numeric))) else 0 end
        else 0
      end
workerPolicy: loan liability is abs(balance); credit_card/check_card are excluded from net worth
scope: No historical backfill. Next successful asset mutation updates only the requested month, as before.
